[Subtitle(text="(Unknown language, unknown time)", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]

[Subtitle(text="The stargate's remodeling plan is an apparent success, and we have re-established a connection with Talos. A two-year backlog of information has been flooding in, but it is bare of any good tidings.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: The stargate's remodeling plan is an apparent success, and we have re-established a connection with Talos. A two-year backlog of information has been flooding in, but it is bare of any good tidings.

raw: [Subtitle(text="First it was the observatory stations on the asteroid belt, then the entire system's interstellar hub. Finally, the cruise fleets orbiting hospitable planets also fell into silence.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: First it was the observatory stations on the asteroid belt, then the entire system's interstellar hub. Finally, the cruise fleets orbiting hospitable planets also fell into silence.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Even the ancient colonial fleet turned into a nomadic museum was not spared the same fate.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Even the ancient colonial fleet turned into a nomadic museum was not spared the same fate.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Along with these shocking revelations came similarly unexpected data left behind by Valeria. Her notes resembled her very being: long-winded and inexhaustible.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Along with these shocking revelations came similarly unexpected data left behind by Valeria. Her notes resembled her very being: long-winded and inexhaustible.

raw: [Subtitle(text="However, she seemed to have spent her last days repeatedly poring over literature and history alongside the technical documents. Studying how these great men died, what their last words and epitaphs were...", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: However, she seemed to have spent her last days repeatedly poring over literature and history alongside the technical documents. Studying how these great men died, what their last words and epitaphs were...

raw: [Subtitle(text="Like a child on the day before their coming-of-age ceremony, rifling through their parent's wardrobe in a frantic search for attire dignified enough for an adult.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Like a child on the day before their coming-of-age ceremony, rifling through their parent's wardrobe in a frantic search for attire dignified enough for an adult.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Did she find her own life inadequate? Insufficiently weighty?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Did she find her own life inadequate? Insufficiently weighty?

raw: [Subtitle(text="No, she left practically all that she had at the stargate. If she had lived in the past, wouldn't her achievements have been inserted into the annals of history?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: No, she left practically all that she had at the stargate. If she had lived in the past, wouldn't her achievements have been inserted into the annals of history?

raw: [Subtitle(text="But now it seemed nothing more than a narrow door opened between two tiny locked rooms in the dark. I fear it won't be long before the door is shut once more.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: But now it seemed nothing more than a narrow door opened between two tiny locked rooms in the dark. I fear it won't be long before the door is shut once more.

raw: [Subtitle(text="In the end, the history of humanity has exceeded the bounds of humanity itself, hah.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: In the end, the history of humanity has exceeded the bounds of humanity itself, hah.

content: 'Another world.' Hah, you're right about that.

raw: [name="Avitus"]But I find myself undeserving of the title Magister. Often times I find myself lost in confusion.

raw: [name="Avitus"]Jordi, do you remember when I told you that blood ties were unimportant?
speaker: Avitus
content: Jordi, do you remember when I told you that blood ties were unimportant?

speaker: Jordi
content: I do, but I already...

raw: [name="Avitus"]I may have been a bit misleading. While we indeed care little for blood relations, 'relationships' themselves are an excellent lead to follow.
speaker: Avitus
content: I may have been a bit misleading. While we indeed care little for blood relations, 'relationships' themselves are an excellent lead to follow.

raw: [name="Avitus"]When one is lost, one ought to find a connection to reality—be it a life or an ideal—and seek a way out.
speaker: Avitus
content: When one is lost, one ought to find a connection to reality—be it a life or an ideal—and seek a way out.

raw: [name="Avitus"]Otherwise you'll end up like me, sinking into an extended questioning of the value of your own existence.
speaker: Avitus
content: Otherwise you'll end up like me, sinking into an extended questioning of the value of your own existence.

raw: [name="Jordi"]If I may be so bold, can I ask whatyour own 'relationship' is...?
speaker: Jordi
content: If I may be so bold, can I ask whatyour own 'relationship' is...?

speaker: Avitus
content: My Familiar.

speaker: Jordi
content: How, exactly...?

raw: [name="Avitus"]She shared the same thoughts and goals, and would enrich both my spirit and my ideas. I loved her as ardently as I loved Ægir, as well as everything we've done for it.
speaker: Avitus
content: She shared the same thoughts and goals, and would enrich both my spirit and my ideas. I loved her as ardently as I loved Ægir, as well as everything we've done for it.

raw: [name="Avitus"]I live a life surrounded by mountains of prehistoric material written in their strange script and incomprehensible grammar... I enjoy the process of translating it into Ægirian text.
speaker: Avitus
content: I live a life surrounded by mountains of prehistoric material written in their strange script and incomprehensible grammar... I enjoy the process of translating it into Ægirian text.

raw: [name="Avitus"]That was how we met, and I still remember how she'd throw herself into her work... Her eyebrows seemed to dance whenever she talked about something of interest to her.
speaker: Avitus
content: That was how we met, and I still remember how she'd throw herself into her work... Her eyebrows seemed to dance whenever she talked about something of interest to her.

raw: [name="Avitus"]And when I told her so, in those exact words, she actually went to the Institute of Physical Art to find out if eyebrows could dance for real.
speaker: Avitus
content: And when I told her so, in those exact words, she actually went to the Institute of Physical Art to find out if eyebrows could dance for real.

raw: [name="Jordi"]What a strange form of art... Did they manage it?
speaker: Jordi
content: What a strange form of art... Did they manage it?

raw: [name="Avitus"]Strictly speaking, no. But some of their researchers were inspired to later develop the technology to make hair dance on its own.
speaker: Avitus
content: Strictly speaking, no. But some of their researchers were inspired to later develop the technology to make hair dance on its own.

raw: [name="Avitus"]We've experienced the catastrophe that silenced the entire sea, and the Seaborn continue to threaten our existence, but we remain committed to exploring science, art, and our vision for the future.
speaker: Avitus
content: We've experienced the catastrophe that silenced the entire sea, and the Seaborn continue to threaten our existence, but we remain committed to exploring science, art, and our vision for the future.

raw: [name="Avitus"]Lava bridges that pump power from the planet's mantle, aquatic artery hubs that transform currents into fountains, artificial suns illuminating the depths of the oceanic abyss, and ecological bases filling the barren seafloor with life...
speaker: Avitus
content: Lava bridges that pump power from the planet's mantle, aquatic artery hubs that transform currents into fountains, artificial suns illuminating the depths of the oceanic abyss, and ecological bases filling the barren seafloor with life...

raw: [name="Avitus"]We persist in transforming what the Predecessors lost into mystical megastructures. We need only a spark to spur on countless inventions.
speaker: Avitus
content: We persist in transforming what the Predecessors lost into mystical megastructures. We need only a spark to spur on countless inventions.

raw: [name="Avitus"]One hundred fifty years is truly too short.
speaker: Avitus
content: One hundred fifty years is truly too short.

speaker: Jordi
content: One hundred and fifty years?

raw: [name="Avitus"]Yes, the average lifespan of an Ægir.
speaker: Avitus
content: Yes, the average lifespan of an Ægir.

speaker: Jordi
content: 'Short,' you say...

raw: [name="Avitus"]The more dangerous the era, the more valuable our creations become.
speaker: Avitus
content: The more dangerous the era, the more valuable our creations become.

raw: [name="Avitus"]We firmly believed in living fulfilling lives, and would gladly have gone to our end without regrets as we passed down the fire of civilization.
speaker: Avitus
content: We firmly believed in living fulfilling lives, and would gladly have gone to our end without regrets as we passed down the fire of civilization.

raw: [name="Avitus"]We planned an educational system we believed was better than the Institute of Incubation.
speaker: Avitus
content: We planned an educational system we believed was better than the Institute of Incubation.

raw: [name="Avitus"]Once our child was born via the incubator, we would raise them ourselves. They would possess a surging spirit and fresh ideologies, and become part of a more creative generation.
speaker: Avitus
content: Once our child was born via the incubator, we would raise them ourselves. They would possess a surging spirit and fresh ideologies, and become part of a more creative generation.

raw: [name="Avitus"]It is unusual to raise children personally, but we had hoped to pass on the values we treasured from the fulfilling lives we'd lived.
speaker: Avitus
content: It is unusual to raise children personally, but we had hoped to pass on the values we treasured from the fulfilling lives we'd lived.

content: So, what happened to her?

speaker: Avitus
content: Dead.

raw: [name="Avitus"]Remember the Predecessor mentioned in 'The Death of Life'?
speaker: Avitus
content: Remember the Predecessor mentioned in 'The Death of Life'?

raw: [name="Avitus"]He took shelter in an unknown refuge as he watched the sky pressing down on the earth every day. He already had a premonition of his own end.
speaker: Avitus

raw: [name="Avitus"]Give it fifty years, maybe a hundred, and even the vast ocean may no longer hold a single drop of pure water.

raw: [name="Avitus"]My apologies, Jordi. I was supposed to be providing you guidance, wasn't I? I've already severed my relationship with the real world, but perhaps you have someone or something you still have ties with?

raw: [name="Blandus"]I saw your documents from the Institute of Development Planning. You'd written 'genetic research' in the box asking for your aspirations.

raw: [name="Blandus"]In the hundred plus years before that, it was never afforded any systematic scrutiny or research. Only endless debates.

content: In the hundred plus years before that, it was never afforded any systematic scrutiny or research. Only endless debates.

raw: [name="Blandus"]To exploit our countrymen and integrate the flesh of other species into ourselves to save our humanity was tantamount to toppling the very foundations of Ægir.

raw: [name="Blandus"]And perhaps he will save Ægir someday, but our country should not be founded upon boundless self-sacrifice.
